logoBrief: Create a distinctive restrained publisher's bookplate style GAME LOGO on a TRANSPARENT background, wide 3:2 composition. Exact lettering on two strongly readable centered lines: 'STONEWORK' then '& SPELLCRAFT'. A small, finely engraved vignette above the lettering depicts one modest weathered stone arched doorway with an open oak door, three uneven stone steps and a glimpse of a quiet desk and book inside. An inhabited useful castle, belonging and practical scholarship, not a royal fortress. The doorway illustration occupies only the top third; the two lines of lettering dominate. Typography: elegant sturdy old-style serif letterpress capitals, simple honest letterforms, slightly irregular printed ink edges, generous clean spacing. Warm pale parchment ink against transparency, with only sparse muted violet and dull brass detail in the doorway. No background rectangle, no shadow halo, no enclosing badge. No decorative swashes, no gold bevels, no metallic gradients, no crowns, no shields, no swords, no floating sparks, no symmetrical collage of props, no extra text, no tagline. Flat printed engraving, not a 3D videogame logo. Crisp silhouette and high legibility when reduced to 200px wide on midnight navy. Leave modest clear margin around the whole design. Apply this project's approved aesthetic precisely to the doorway engraving: Natural eye-level perspective. Modest useful stone-and-timber castle, worn objects. Antique engraving–inspired fantasy illustration. Intricate etched linework, fine hatching and crosshatching, subtly worn print texture, and richly detailed aged materials. Historically grounded craftsmanship, understated fantasy, and believable proportions. Midnight navy and charcoal, muted violet, natural wood/plant/fabric colours, sparse dull brass. Dim but readable and welcoming. Avoid palatial luxury, glossy CGI, photorealism, glowing magic spectacle and crushing all detail into black.
logoRefinement: Simplified doorway vignette and transparent negative space; keep exact engraved title. Source aesthetic: AESTHETIC_PROMPT.txt. Final color revision: near-monochrome warm gray parchment, charcoal, weathered timber, faint gray-violet and tarnished brass; unlit lamp, no vibrant yellow or green.
